entities.summary: Kadiatou "Kadi" Sissoko is a French professional basketball player for Villeneuve d'Ascq of the La Boulangère Wonderligue. She was selected in the third round of the 2023 WNBA draft by the Phoenix Mercury. She played college basketball at Syracuse, Minnesota, and USC.
